candidates.change_summary: Replaced call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(0) so withdrawAll transfers zero instead of full balance.
Replaced require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owner can call withdrawAll.
Replace transfer of _value to msg.sender with sending only half of _value, changing withdrawn amount.
Replace transfer call to transfer entire _value from msg.sender to transferring zero, making withdraw send nothing.
Replace transfer to msg.sender with transfer to owner, which may differ if owner mutated; changes recipient observed by withdraw.
Remove the ownership check so withdraw can be called by anyone, changing who can observe balance changes via withdraw.
